# Proposal

## Why

Users need a quick way to greet someone from the command line; there is no CLI yet.

## What Changes

- Add a `greet` command that prints a greeting for a given name.
- Default to greeting "World" when no name is given.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `greeting`: Printing greetings from the command line.

### Modified Capabilities

## Impact

New `greet` binary; no existing code affected.
